messages:
elena: Quick workshop recap — we need to lock the Console observability scope for the next quarter. Main customer asks: token-level cost dashboards, trace deep-linking from UI, better error grouping + regression alerts, and per-customer retention controls.

sam: Can we split into M1 (must-have) vs M2 (nice-to-have)? I think M1 should be: dashboards (cost + latency), basic error grouping, retention UI for default + enterprise tier, and trace links.

mike: Agreed on M1. Tracing deep sampling + linking is medium effort (kv store + UI hooks). Full span visualization is M2.

jordan: We need clear SLOs for each piece. Propose: dashboards live -> 99.9% availability, trace link latency <300ms for deep-link lookup, retention policy changes apply within 15m. Thoughts?

anika: Quick cost estimate for retention tiers based on current telemetry: default 30d => +$10k/month; enterprise 365d => additional +$48k/month at current ingestion. We can mitigate with cold storage + lower retention resolution for older data.

nora: UX constraints: retention controls must be one-click per-org and a bulk CSV option. For dashboards: default saved views (cost, latency, errors) and a compact embed for support tickets.

sam: Proposed M1 rollout list: 1) cost & latency dashboards (token-level aggregations + model breakdown) 2) error grouping (stack-based dedupe + first-seen trend) 3) retention control UI (default 30d, enterprise 365d) 4) trace deep-link (open trace in APM)

sam: Config snippet for retention we'll expose in API and UI: 
```
retention:
  default_days: 30
  tiers:
    - name: standard
      days: 30
    - name: enterprise
      days: 365
```

elena: Launch criteria for M1 (need agreement): - Dashboards have sample data and 3 saved views - Error grouping identifies top 10 regressions and sends alerts - Retention UI toggles and backend enforcement tested - Trace deep-link opens trace context from request detail page. All with docs and one customer pilot.

mike: Risks: storage cost + queries on long retention; we should add a hard cap per-org and warn customers on enable. Also need data migration plan for orgs requesting >30d.

anika: Ops for cost mitigation: add downsampling at 30/90/365 day boundaries, and index only key fields after 90d. I can draft a cost projection table if we decide tiers.

jordan: Security and compliance: enterprise retention must respect KMS keys and export controls. Private deployments might require local retention enforcement — flagging as blocker for Private product lane.

nora: UX acceptance criteria: retention change flow with confirmation modal, inline cost estimate, and a CTA to contact sales for enterprise enablement.

elena: Prioritization ask: customers A & B asked for immediate retention and dashboards (they're on Dedicated). They want pilot in 6 weeks. Can eng commit to that?

sam: 6 weeks is tight but doable if we scope M1 tightly and reassign two engs from infra for 4 weeks. Need docs + QA buffer.

mike: I'll take ownership of tracing links + backend TTL enforcement. Jordan can own SLO instrumentation. Sam will coordinate eng resourcing.

jordan: I'll draft SLO/alert playbook and run book for oncall.

anika: I'll produce the cost projection spreadsheet and a query budget calc for enterprise orgs by EOD Tue.

nora: I'll mock the retention UI and saved-dashboard UX by Friday.

elena: Action items + owners: - M1 scope final by Tue (elena, sam) - Cost projection (anika) - Retention UI mock (nora) - Tracing link prototype (mike) - SLO playbook (jordan) - Pilot runbook + invite list (elena)

ops-bot: Reminder: engineering weekly sync is Wed 10:00 — flag any blockers before then.

elena: OK — if we all hit these, we'll commit to the 6-week pilot. Please update the roadmap card in the product board with final scope and owners. :thumbsup:
